metadata.note: Curated technical dictionary for code-switched (Hinglish) to Gondi translation. Maps English/Hindi technical terms to Gondi using ITRANS romanization. Entries marked with '*' are high-frequency in speech processing domain.

notes.pronunciation_guide: ITRANS romanization follows standard Hindi/Sanskrit transliteration conventions
notes.dialect_variation: Gondi has regional variations; this dictionary uses standard Gondi from Madhya Pradesh
notes.pluralization: Gondi nouns generally do not change form for plurals; context determines number
notes.gender_notes: Gondi is not significantly gendered (unlike Hindi); terms apply universally
notes.usage_context: Technical terms may need contextual interpretation in traditional Gondi speakers' usage
